python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
print(len(items))
for start in range(0,len(items),5):
 rows=[]
 for j,it in enumerate(items[start:start+5],start+1):
  w=Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB'); l=Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
  canvas=Image.new('RGB',(max(1200,w.width+20,l.width+20),w.height+l.height+48),'white')
  ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((5,3),str(j)+' '+it['item_id'],fill='black')
  canvas.paste(w,(10,25)); canvas.paste(l,(10,30+w.height));rows.append(canvas)
 out=Image.new('RGB',(max(x.width for x in rows),sum(x.height for x in rows)),'white');y=0
 for r in rows:out.paste(r,(0,y));y+=r.height
 out.save(f'zoom/b{start//5:02}.png')
PY

print(len(a))
